notes.title: RIP Soul King (Update 1_2_3)
notes.content:
Folks, 

This is our final planned update for Soul King. I'm finally closing down the source files and putting them in storage. This is absolutely my favorite game we've made, I still regularly play it for fun, even after hundreds of hours. I really hope you all enjoyed playing Soul King half as much as we enjoyed making it. 

We're moving on to another project, this time centered around oral histories of our state (Alaska) but we fully intend on returning to the Barclay Reserve one day with a continuation of Lynn's story in "Soul Kingdom".

Thanks, 
Wyatt White
CakeNeq Games

Changes
[list]
[*] Fixed some level layout issues
[*] Fixed some typos
[*] Fixed some phrasing
[*] Fixed title drop being the wrong size with new assets
[*] Updated some assets
[*] Fixed new soundtracking
[/list]

notes.title: Grimzo's Gauntlet is here!
notes.content:
[h2]The Gauntlet is here! [/h2]

An unassuming wall crumbles away in the Barclay Reserve Rapid Transit station to reveal a strange prototype machine named Boxler. It has a strange story to tell, of an inventor named Grimzo locked away in a forgotten dream and that it was sent to ready Lynn for a dangerous quest to free Grimzo. 

The Gauntlet provides a remix experience of the Soul King maps you've grown to love (and sometimes hate) providing both on-demand remixed levels as well as a weekly competitive remix that allows you to compete with other players for leaderboard placement. Each of these generated levels includes all-new finales with challenge-focused final maps that are sure to push your skills and our tools to the max, as well as small story connections that hint at what may be in store for Lynn in her next quest.

The Gauntlet is a whole new way to play Soul King, and is available for all Soul King players today!!

notes.title: Update 1_0_11
notes.content:
A wild patch has appeared!

There's nothing too huge in this one, but we've been hard at work on new stuff and we wanted to get all these changes pushed out to everyone before we really lock-in on our new expansion content. 

Changes in this update:
[list]
[*]Fixed some inconsistent Tea interactions
[*]Reduced base wall-speed slightly (2.5 pps -> 2.2 pps)
[*]Offhand Reloads now only pause when you switch back to a weapon
[*]Smoothed out bumping into walls (still will slow you down, but less bump/reduction)
[*]Added Helper Coffee (included in Dynamic Difficulty, spawns a powerfull Coffee pickup to help out players who are struggling)
[*]Ammo Pickups now accellerate reloading and offhand reloading by more
[*]Added Quick-Turn (For controller and Keyb-only players, turns the player 180 degrees in 1/3 a second)
[*]Fake Lighting (Players viewmodel and enemies are now recolored to mimic lighting changes, real basic stuff)
[*]Fixed Several spelling issues
[*]Keyboard/Gamepad control checks are now done consistently through play, not just when the game boots
[*]Fullscreen is now default for new players (sorry, that was a rookie mistake)
[/list]
